description: Explains the strong / medium / small rating and gives the historical record: for past unlocks of each strength, how often the token fell against Bitcoin in the week before the unlock and the average move. Use when the user asks what 'strong' means, whether unlocks move prices, or how reliable the rating is. Not a forecast for any single token.
name: get_method_and_track_record
title: How unlocks are rated, and what happened before past ones
